fxAssets.name: Euro / US Dollar
fxAssets.description: Most liquid global FX pair driven by ECB and Federal Reserve rate expectations, Eurozone inflation data, and US Treasury yield differentials.

fxAssets.name: British Pound / US Dollar
fxAssets.description: High-beta major currency pair sensitive to Bank of England policy guidance, UK CPI releases, and London-New York session overlap flows.

fxAssets.name: US Dollar / Japanese Yen
fxAssets.description: Carry-trade benchmark tracking the spread between US 10Y yields and Bank of Japan yield curve control policy.

fxAssets.name: US Dollar / Swiss Franc
fxAssets.description: Defensive European currency pair shaped by Swiss National Bank inflation targets and global risk-on / risk-off capital rotation.

fxAssets.name: Australian Dollar / US Dollar
fxAssets.description: Commodity-linked major pair closely correlated with iron ore, copper prices, RBA cash rate guidance, and Asia-Pacific industrial demand.

fxAssets.name: Euro / British Pound
fxAssets.description: Low-noise European cross pair reflecting relative growth momentum and central bank divergence between the ECB and Bank of England.

fxAssets.name: Euro / Japanese Yen
fxAssets.description: Active momentum cross tracking European risk appetite and Japanese monetary policy normalization.

fxAssets.name: US 10-Year Treasury Note
fxAssets.description: Global risk-free benchmark debt instrument. Yield moves reflect inflation expectations, Federal Reserve dot-plot guidance, and Treasury auction demand.

fxAssets.name: US 30-Year Treasury Bond
fxAssets.description: Long-duration US government bond highly sensitive to fiscal deficit outlooks, long-run GDP growth, and institutional pension allocation.

fxAssets.name: UK 10-Year Gilt
fxAssets.description: HM Treasury benchmark gilt priced off UK wage growth, BoE Bank Rate expectations, and DMO gilt supply schedules.

fxAssets.name: German 10-Year Bund
fxAssets.description: Core Eurozone sovereign benchmark pricing European credit spreads, ECB quantitative tightening, and industrial sentiment.

fxAssets.name: US Investment Grade Bond Index
fxAssets.description: Diversified basket of AAA–BBB rated US corporate debt securities tracking credit spreads and corporate balance-sheet health.

fxAssets.name: Apple Inc.
fxAssets.description: Mega-cap consumer hardware and high-margin services ecosystem leader backed by recurring App Store, iCloud, and silicon innovation.

fxAssets.name: Microsoft Corp.
fxAssets.description: Global enterprise software and Azure cloud infrastructure powerhouse with strong recurring institutional SaaS cash flows.

fxAssets.name: NVIDIA Corp.
fxAssets.description: Leading accelerated computing and data-center GPU designer with high institutional volume and strong earnings momentum.

fxAssets.name: Tesla Inc.
fxAssets.description: High-volatility electric vehicle, grid-scale battery storage, and autonomous mobility manufacturer favored by active momentum traders.

fxAssets.name: Amazon.com Inc.
fxAssets.description: Dominant global e-commerce fulfillment network and AWS cloud leader supported by expanding retail operating margins and digital ads.

fxAssets.name: Alphabet Inc.
fxAssets.description: Search, YouTube, and Google Cloud parent generating resilient advertising revenue and deep balance-sheet liquidity.
